summary: Implemented the stubs in middlewares.py (CachingMiddleware read, write, flush and close), operations.py (delete, add, subtract, set, increment and decrement as update transforms) and utils.py (with_typehint, the LRUCache lru, length, clear, get and set members, the _immutable helper with FrozenDict pop/update, and freeze). The last full-suite run gave 32 passed and 169 failed; tests/test_utils.py passes fully, and the remaining middleware and operations failures trace to table.py and database.py stubs owned by other builders.
